messages:
sam: quickstart oddity — my sample app GET /v1/embeddings returns 302 -> /billing/checkout even though CLI said onboarding passed. no card on file. anyone? :thinking:

rachel: can you paste the curl -I? might be a gateway HTML redirect.

sam: quick paste:
```
$ curl -I -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-test-abc' https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/embeddings
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://console.redwood-inference.example/billing/checkout?reason=firstcall
```

kai: sounds like our UI layer is treating Accept negotiation poorly. browsers get redirected to checkout; API clients should get 402 JSON. many quickstarts rely on fetch defaults which send Accept: */*.

rachel: quick workaround: add `-H 'Accept: application/json'` or set fetch header to request JSON. that forces the API to return machine-readable billing error.

sam: adding Accept fixed my CI. thanks. what about SDKs?

kai: SDKs should set Accept: application/json by default. filing ENG-5151 to update gateway content-negotiation and quickstart snippets. will also make retries treat 3xx as non-retry for POSTs.

ci-bot: ENG-5151 opened and canary deployed to dev at 3529001265 :white_check_mark:

sam: verified canary — now receives 402 JSON with {"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"Add billing info to complete first call"}} when Accept set. leaving this thread unless regressions appear. :thumbsup:
